description: Searches the open x402 Bazaar index (run by Coinbase CDP) for paid APIs outside Wafermap's own catalog, such as weather, web search, data enrichment or token prices. Returns each service's URL, HTTP method, price, accepted networks, an example input and whether Wafermap can pay it (payable = accepts USDG on Robinhood Chain or USDC on Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Arc or Soneium). Use it when no Wafermap resource fits the task. Free, no payment needed.

limit.description: How many services to return (default 10, max 20).

query.description: What you need in a few words, e.g. "weather forecast" or "web search".

name: wafermap_discover
title: Find third-party x402 services
